s108.sec5.u0: Hey hey, news! Um, so... while your Digimon is still a baby, try doing the same training over and over. They say something good happens!
s108.sec5.u1: Hey hey, news! Um, so... in a Bonus Try, if you line up the same picture as the one on the sign, the boost gets even bigger!
s108.sec5.u2: Oh right, I said I'd tell you about techniques. Usually, after a battle, your Digimon learns a technique the enemy used on it. Only one it can equip right now, though. It doesn't work every time, but it's the quickest way to get more techniques. And then... the chances are really low, but you can also learn one through training. Once Brains are pretty high, doing the training at {color 6}{player}{color 1}'s Classroom can teach one, they say. I know I keep saying it, but the chances really are low, so don't count on it too much. Balance is what matters!
s108.sec5.u3: Hey hey, I'm Koromon! Jiji asked me to teach
s108.sec5.u4: Training here raises your Digimon's stats. But training makes it tired, and it takes a good while, too. Still, it's a surer way to raise stats than battling. And once in a blue moon, your Digimon learns a new technique! I'll tell you about techniques another time.
s108.sec5.u5: There are six pieces of training equipment here, and each one has a sign next to it.

s108.sec81.u2: Pushing a huge boulder builds raw strength. Max HP goes up a lot, and Offense too.
s108.sec82.u2: Standing under a waterfall steels the spirit. Max MP goes up a lot, and Defense too.
s108.sec83.u2: Practice techniques on a tree. Offense goes up a lot, and Speed too.
s108.sec84.u2: Take hits from a giant punching machine. Defense goes up a lot, and Brains too.
s108.sec85.u2: Run laps of the course, again and again. Speed goes up a lot, and Max HP too.
